name: Reranking
short_description: Reranking is a retrieval step in which a second model rescores the top candidates returned by a search so the most relevant results are passed on, for example to a language model in a RAG pipeline.

evidence.quote: pull the full precision data and re-rank the results
This is where we introduce the L2 re-ranca.
It solves the most common failure mode in rag, the wrong order problem.
topped off with a semantic reranker that's built into Azure AI Search.
When retrieval is weak and rerank is missing, low signal chunks crowd high signal passages
